// diagnostic

E0116

Valueless call used as a value

What

Valueless call used as a value

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Use a value-producing call here, or discard the valueless call as a statement.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0116: tests/ui/qq_unit_call_tail.stderr.

Error [jet.ValuelessCallUsedAsValue]: `print` doesn't hand back a value
  --> tests/ui/qq_unit_call_tail.jet:4:19
    |
  4 |     save("") ?? { print("save failed") }
    |                   ^^^^^
 Why: A `??` fallback block ends with a value or leaves the enclosing function; a call that returns nothing is only a statement
 Fix: End the block with `()` after the call, or use `return` to leave the enclosing function
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0116
